name: local-full-ai
description: A private AI coding assistant for VS Code, powered by local Ollama models, with optional free cloud models when local ones are too weak: chat, edit your project with approval, autopilot, helper agents, voice input and model management.

commands.title: Local Full AI: Select / Download Model
Local Full AI: Ask About Selected Code
Local Full AI: Copy Diagnostics for a Bug Report

localAI.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Address of the local Ollama server

localAI.useClaudeSkills.description: Load your Claude skills (~/.claude/skills and <project>/.claude/skills) and CLAUDE.md files into the chat. Use /skill-name in the chat or let the model pick one.

localAI.extraSkillFolders.description: Extra folders that contain skills (each skill is a subfolder with a SKILL.md).

localAI.responseMode.description: How the model answers. Precise (low temperature) is the most reliable for code and tool use.

localAI.temperature.description: Randomness for the Custom response mode.

localAI.topP.description: Nucleus sampling for the Custom response mode.

localAI.topK.description: Top-K sampling for the Custom response mode.

localAI.repeatPenalty.description: Repeat penalty for the Custom response mode.

localAI.gpuLayers.description: How many model layers run on the GPU. -1 = automatic, 0 = CPU only.

level.description: none = hidden, read = read only, ask = every edit/command needs approval, full = follows the permission mode

localAI.folderAccess.description: Folders the AI may use and how far it may go in each. The deepest matching folder wins. Project folders default to full.

localAI.workingFolder.description: Folder the AI works from (relative paths and commands). Empty means the open project folder.

localAI.unloadModelsOnClose.description: When VS Code closes, unload the models from RAM if Ollama was started by something other than this extension. A server started by this extension is stopped completely.

localAI.autoSkills.description: Pick the skills that match each request and give them to the model directly, so skills work with every model (no tool calling needed).

localAI.cloudContextSize.description: How many tokens of chat and project context are sent to a cloud model. Free tiers have small per-minute token limits, so keep this modest.

localAI.multiAgent.description: Let the main chat start helper agents (delegate_task) for research and sub-tasks.

localAI.subagentModel.description: Model for research helper agents. Empty = same as the chat, "auto" = the smallest installed model, or an exact model name. A small model is fast for simple reading tasks; helpers that edit files always use the chat model.

enumDescriptions: After the AI changes files: quick checks (syntax, broken links) always, plus a reviewer agent when the model is big enough and the cloud limits allow it
Always add the reviewer agent, also for cloud models with small free limits
localAI.verifyChanges.description: Check the AI's changes when it finishes a task and let it fix what is broken (up to 2 rounds).

localAI.autopilotCommands.description: Extra commands autopilot may run without asking, as prefixes (for example "docker compose ps"). By default it only runs commands that test, build, lint or inspect the project.

localAI.language.description: Language of the sidebar and chat interface: "auto" follows VS Code, "en" English, "uk" Ukrainian. Applies when the panel is opened again. Messages from VS Code itself (pickers, notifications) stay in English.

localAI.voiceEngine.description: Speech recognition for voice input: "local" (offline whisper.cpp, nothing leaves the computer) or "groq" (Groq Whisper in the cloud: fast and accurate, needs the Groq key, the recording is sent to Groq).

localAI.voiceLanguage.description: Language for voice input (whisper language code such as en, uk, ru) or auto to detect.

localAI.whisperBinaryPath.description: Path to whisper-cli (whisper.cpp). Empty means search PATH and Homebrew.

localAI.whisperModelPath.description: Path to a whisper.cpp ggml model. Empty means ~/.local-full-ai/whisper/ggml-base.bin.

localAI.contextSize.description: Context window (tokens) requested from Ollama. Larger values remember more of the project but use more RAM.

localAI.selectedModel.description: Currently selected model (filled in automatically via 'Select Model')

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the AI can only chat. It cannot read, edit or run anything in your folder.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Project tools (reading, editing, commands) need a real folder on disk; the chat itself works everywhere.
